d: In this video, Firstpost explains why a Muslim woman's Islamic preaching stall in London has sparked a heated social media debate. Seen playing Quran recitations over a loudspeaker during the Christmas shopping season, she has drawn both support and criticism. While some defend her right to share her faith, others question the noise and disruption. The controversy has also brought attention to protests against a Sikh-owned restaurant in West London over its refusal to serve halal meat. But what does British law say about street preaching, religious freedom and loudspeaker use? Firstpost…
